reason: A local browser-based utility for inspecting and deleting DeepSeek Harness sessions, including related storage cleanup, optional backups, and post-deletion verification.

summaries.zh: 通过本地网页界面查看并删除 DeepSeek Harness 会话，同时清理相关存储记录并支持删除前备份。
summaries.en: A local web-based utility for viewing and deleting DeepSeek Harness sessions while cleaning related storage records and optionally creating backups.

capabilities: Starts a local Node.js web service
Reads and displays DeepSeek Harness session metadata and storage files
Deletes selected session directories and related session records
Rewrites workspace and project-cache JSON storage files
Creates optional local backups and verifies deletion remnants
Checks whether the DeepSeek Harness process is running before deletion
